note: Raw detections, per sensor; never add sensors to count unique fires. Nominal/high VIIRS and MODIS confidence >=30 kept. Static heat can remain. Country assignment uses generalized boundaries; unmatched coastal/offshore points are reported separately. Coverage and fire absence are not established by these counts.
